title: Storm and flood disaster recovery small business grants – Guidelines
summary: This page provides guidelines for small businesses applying for storm and flood disaster recovery grants.
who_can_apply: Small businesses affected by storms and floods.

internal_links.text: Disaster recovery small business grant – storms and floods August and September 2022 onwards
June and July 2022 Storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant
February and March 2022 storm and flood disaster recovery small business grant

faqs.q: What grants are available for storm and flood damage?
faqs.a: The page provides guidelines for different grant periods, including those for August and September 2022 onwards, June and July 2022, and February and March 2022.

faqs.q: Where can I find the guidelines for the most recent grant period?
faqs.a: The guidelines for the August and September 2022 onwards grant are available here: https://www.service.nsw.gov.au/guidelines/disaster-recovery-small-business-grant-storms-floods-august-september-2022

faqs.q: Are there guidelines for previous grant periods?
faqs.a: Yes, guidelines are available for the June and July 2022 period and the February and March 2022 period.
